name: comp-327
title: Invite Members Dialog
blurb: Invite team members via email or shareable magic link.
description: A shadcn Dialog with dynamically addable email input fields and a read-only magic link with copy-to-clipboard button.
use_when: Onboarding team members through email invitations or sharing referral links with your product.
avoid_when: When you have no referral or team invitation system — the component assumes both email and link-based invitation are…
a11y: Email fields are properly labeled; copy button has aria-label; tooltip uses TooltipProvider; keyboard navigation fully supported.
